# pkc/why

> pkc: packenger why — why a package is part of a program's build (port of Result.Why).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/why.pkg)

`wy_why(r, file, name, target)` returns the explanation: the shortest
chain of use lines, truck members, needs, translations and includes from
the program to the package, the other packages that ask for it, and the
resolve rules that rename things in it. It fails if the package isn't
part of the build.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
// one reason a package is loaded: from asks for to
struct WyEdge
  from: str
  to: str
  line: str
end

fn wy_add(out: ptr Vec, from: str, to: str, line: str)
  let e = new WyEdge
  e.from = from
  e.to = to
  e.line = line
  vec_push(out, e as int)
end

fn wy_sorted(m: ptr Map) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  for i = 0 to map_len(m) - 1
    vec_push_str(out, map_key(m, i))
  end
  sort_strs(out)
  return out
end

// wy_edges lists every reason a package of the build is loaded, in the
// Go compiler's order.
fn wy_edges(r: ptr DrResult, file: str, target: str) -> ptr Vec
  let out = vec_new()
  let uses = r.front.uses
  for i = 0 to vec_len(uses) - 1
    let u = vec_get_str(uses, i)
    wy_add(out, file, u, str_concat3(file, " uses ", u))
  end
  let front = r.front.front
  let names = wy_sorted(front)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(names) - 1
    let f = map_get(front, vec_get_str(names, i)) as ptr PfFile
    for k = 0 to vec_len(f.truck) - 1
      let to = str_concat3(f.name, "/", vec_get_str(f.truck, k))
      wy_add(out, f.name, to, str_concat3(f.name, " is a truck with member ", to))
    end
    for k = 0 to vec_len(f.needs) - 1
      let n = vec_get_str(f.needs, k)
      wy_add(out, f.name, n, str_concat3(f.name, " needs ", n))
    end
  end
  // the front-end package that defines each kind of node
  let definer = map_new()
  for i = 0 to vec_len(names) - 1
    let f = map_get(front, vec_get_str(names, i)) as ptr PfFile
    if vec_len(f.syntax) > 0
      map_set(definer, pf_kind(f.name), f.name as int)
    end
  end
  let kinds = cg_kinds(r.prog)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(kinds) - 1
    let k = vec_get_str(kinds, i)
    let b = map_get(r.back, k) as ptr PfFile
    if b == null
      continue
    end
    if map_has(definer, k)
      let d = map_get(definer, k) as str
      wy_add(out, d, b.name, str_concat3(d, " is translated by ", b.name))
    else
      wy_add(out, file, b.name, str_concat4(file, " has ", k, str_concat3(" nodes, which ", b.name, " translates")))
    end
  end
  let backs = wy_sorted(r.back)
  for i = 0 to vec_len(backs) - 1
    let b = map_get(r.back, vec_get_str(backs, i)) as ptr PfFile
    let incs = cg_includes(b)
    for k = 0 to vec_len(incs) - 1
      let to = str_concat3(target, "/", vec_get_str(incs, k))
      wy_add(out, b.name, to, str_concat3(b.name, " includes ", to))
    end
    for k = 0 to vec_len(b.needs) - 1
      let n = vec_get_str(b.needs, k)
      wy_add(out, b.name, n, str_concat3(b.name, " needs ", n))
    end
  end
  return out
end

// wy_why returns the explanation, or "" with pk_err set.
fn wy_why(r: ptr DrResult, file: str, name: str, target: str) -> str
  let loaded = map_new()
  for i = 0 to map_len(r.front.front) - 1
    map_set(loaded, map_key(r.front.front, i), 1)
  end
  for i = 0 to map_len(r.back) - 1
    map_set(loaded, (map_value(r.back, i) as ptr PfFile).name, 1)
  end
  if !map_has(loaded, name)
    u_fail(str_concat4(name, " is not part of the build of ", file, " (packenger tree lists what is)"))
    return ""
  end
  let edges = wy_edges(r, file, target)
  // breadth-first from the program, edges in order: the first path found
  // is the shortest, and always the same one
  let via = map_new()
  map_set(via, file, -1)
  let queue = vec_new()
  vec_push_str(queue, file)
  let at = 0
  while at < vec_len(queue) && !map_has(via, name)
    let from = vec_get_str(queue, at)
    at = at + 1
    for i = 0 to vec_len(edges) - 1
      let e = vec_get(edges, i) as ptr WyEdge
      if e.from == from && !map_has(via, e.to) && map_has(loaded, e.to)
        map_set(via, e.to, i)
        vec_push_str(queue, e.to)
      end
    end
  end
  let b = sb_new()
  sb_add(b, str_concat4(name, " is part of the build of ", file, ":\n"))
  let path = vec_new()
  let last = ""
  let cur = name
  while map_has(via, cur) && map_get(via, cur) >= 0
    let e = vec_get(edges, map_get(via, cur)) as ptr WyEdge
    if last == ""
      last = e.from
    end
    vec_push_str(path, e.line)
    cur = e.from
  end
  let i = vec_len(path) - 1
  while i >= 0
    sb_add(b, str_concat3("  ", vec_get_str(path, i), "\n"))
    i = i - 1
  end
  let others = map_new()
  for k = 0 to vec_len(edges) - 1
    let e = vec_get(edges, k) as ptr WyEdge
    if e.to == name && e.from != last
      map_set(others, e.from, 1)
    end
  end
  if map_len(others) > 0
    sb_add(b, str_concat3("also asked for by ", str_join(wy_sorted(others), ", "), "\n"))
  end
  let rules = rs_rules(r.front.front)
  for k = 0 to vec_len(rules) - 1
    let ra = vec_get(rules, k) as ptr RsRule
    if rs_in_scope(name, ra.r.scope)
      sb_add(b, str_concat4("renamed by ", ra.f.name, ":", str_concat4(str_from_int(ra.r.line), ": ", pf_rename_string(ra.r), "\n")))
    end
  end
  return sb_str(b)
end
```
